answer_2.quote: Accuracy for LXMERT, when trained and evaluated on the same subset of data, is 71.7%; ... faithfulness scores are measured using precision, recall, and F1.

answer_4.quote: We collect human-annotated intermediate outputs for 536 examples in NLVR2 and for 215 examples in DROP to measure the module-wise faithfulness of models... The annotator draws the correct bounding-boxes for each module in the gold program.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators draw the correct bounding boxes (or spans) for each module in the gold program to create gold annotations used for evaluation.
